changed_steps.Register built AU:
set -euo pipefail
AU_SOURCE="$PWD/build/CS80Reference_artefacts/Release/AU/CS-80 Reference.component"
AU_DEST="$HOME/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/CS-80 Reference.component"
test -d "$AU_SOURCE"
codesign --force --sign - "$AU_SOURCE"
mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components"
rm -rf "$AU_DEST"
cp -R "$AU_SOURCE" "$AU_DEST"
diff -qr "$AU_SOURCE" "$AU_DEST"
shasum -a 256 "$AU_SOURCE/Contents/MacOS/CS-80 Reference" \
  "$AU_DEST/Contents/MacOS/CS-80 Reference" | tee au-payload-before-validation.sha256
killall -9 AudioComponentRegistrar || true
sleep 2
ls -ld "$AU_DEST"
changed_steps.Package native macOS VST3, AU and Standa:
